scope: All playable IDs, including X variants; HIGH and LOW
qualification: Diagnostic census and per-ID disposition; not visual acceptance or release qualification
head: 1156f3cdd3183e00f0e3e8fe9eea1ceecaaedff8

contactReclassification.method: Re-evaluate saved candidate triangle pairs with positive-length plane-cut interval overlap; no new native builds or raw report mutations.

limitations: Primary large-stock screen excludes source-labelled equipment, ERA and small parts; full decoration or combat qualification is outside this census.
All emitted triangles in selected parts screened; no triangle-count cutoff. Strict crossing predicate excludes coplanar/shared-vertex contacts.
A merged geometry may contain several deliberately intersecting closed solids. Proper triangle intersections are not automatically malformed individual stock.
Topology keys use10micrometre welding; skinny triangles<=1e-9m2 are omitted from diagnostic faces. These conventions are not a native watertightness gate.
Coordinates are captured owner-local emitted geometry, including builder-applied scalar transforms; not posed world positions.
Mirror test only finds parts with identical reflected boundary signatures. Unmatched asymmetry requires source and rendered inspection.
Concave adjacency can be an intentional gun opening, wheel well, roof step or casting transition. Planar triangle facets can legitimately meet along a crease.
Exposure rays see captured same-owner primary stock, not every fitting. An unobstructed ray is a view nomination, not a screenshot.
Native before/after captures, fill/anatomy regeneration, strict tracks and final release are owned by the integration run and remain separate.
reportEncoding: Coordinates rounded to 1 micrometre for display only; identical LOW candidateParts reference HIGH. Native checks retain full precision.
